module: World Editor "crawl" (rock crawling) data editor, "Crawl Data Editor" window (Gameplay menu). It loads, edits and saves four kinds of objects via gameplay/crawl/saveSystem: trails (routes linking a path, a boundary and a starting position), paths (nodes), boundaries (zones) and starting positions. It also lists objects coming from missions (/gameplay/missions/<level>/crawl/<mission>/). It delegates editing to the submodules crawlEditor/paths, boundaries, trails, startingPositions, input and missionPortTool, registers four edit modes (pathEditMode, boundaryEditMode, startingPositionEditMode, trailEditMode) and permanently draws the selected nodes, boundaries and starting positions. Useful to a modder who creates crawl routes for a level or wants to read the loaded data from another extension.
usage:
extensions.load('editor_crawlEditor')
local trails = editor_crawlEditor.getAllTrails()
local p = editor_crawlEditor.getSelectedPath()
notes: Selection indices (selectedTrailIndex...) start at 1; 0 or -1 = no selection. For trails, paths and boundaries, indices > #allX designate mission objects (missionX[index - #allX]); starting positions have no mission equivalent.
markAsDirty(objectType, index) sets the _dirty flag on the object; its valid types are "trail", "path", "boundary" and "startingPosition". An out-of-range index is ignored without error.

Mission objects are marked _isFromMission = true and _missionName. A trail's Save button moves the trail between the mission folder and the level folder according to the difference between isFromMission (wanted) and _isFromMission (current); moveTrailToMission is local, only moveTrailToLevel is exported.

renameObjectFile refuses to rename if the target already exists, renames the file with FS:renameFile, updates the pathId/boundaryId/startingPositionId(/Reversed) references of the level's trails then resaves the renamed object.

Folders: level files in /levels/<level>/crawls/ (*.trail.json, *.path.json, *.boundary.json, *.startingPosition.json); mission files in /gameplay/missions/<level>/crawl/<mission>/. Loading only happens the first time the window is opened when a level is loaded, or by calling loadAllObjects().
onSerialize/onDeserialized preserve across Lua reloads: currentFileDir, currentFileName, crawlData, currentTab and the four selection indices.
Inconsistency: getAllX() returns the internal (modifiable) tables; the getSelectedX() getters return nil if the index is out of range.

getAllTrails.desc: Returns the list of loaded level trails.

getAllMissionTrails.desc: Returns the list of trails coming from the crawl missions of the current level.

getAllPaths.desc: Returns the list of level paths.

getAllMissionPaths.desc: Returns the list of paths coming from missions.

getAllBoundaries.desc: Returns the list of level boundaries.

getAllMissionBoundaries.desc: Returns the list of boundaries coming from missions.

getAllStartingPositions.desc: Returns the list of starting positions.

getSelectedTrailIndex.desc: Returns the index of the selected trail.

getSelectedPathIndex.desc: Returns the index of the selected path.

getSelectedBoundaryIndex.desc: Returns the index of the selected boundary.

getSelectedStartingPositionIndex.desc: Returns the index of the selected starting position.

setSelectedTrailIndex.desc: Sets the index of the selected trail without touching the other selections.

setSelectedPathIndex.desc: Sets the index of the selected path.

setSelectedBoundaryIndex.desc: Sets the index of the selected boundary.

setSelectedStartingPositionIndex.desc: Sets the index of the selected starting position.

getSelectedTrail.desc: Returns the selected trail (level or mission).

getSelectedPath.desc: Returns the selected path (level or mission).

getSelectedBoundary.desc: Returns the selected boundary (level or mission).

loadAllObjects.desc: Reloads from disk the trails, paths, boundaries and starting positions (via saveSystem.getAll...Files / get...ById), as well as those of the crawl missions of the current level. First clears the in-memory lists.

index.desc: Global index (mission objects included except for startingPosition)

moveTrailToLevel.desc: Moves a mission trail to /levels/<level>/crawls/: rewrites pathId and boundaryId to point to this folder, saves the trail, deletes the old file, then reloads everything. Fails if the trail is not from a mission, if no level is loaded or if the file already exists.

renameObjectFile.desc: Renames the file of a crawl object and updates the trails' references.

returns.desc: true if renamed; false if identical/nil paths, existing target or failure

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the "Crawl Data Editor" window (1800x900), the menu entry (Gameplay group) and the four edit modes with their auxiliary shortcuts. Called once at editor initialization.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame: updates the mouse (crawlEditor/input), draws the permanent overlays (nodes, boundaries, starting positions), the window (File menu with Save All, lists on the left, details on the right, Save/Delete buttons) and the mission porting window.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before Lua reload: returns the current folder/file name, crawlData, current tab and selection indices.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the state returned by onSerialize (indices default to -1).
